metadata.title: Tesla Teases Cybercab Launch Event, But TSLA Stock Isn’t Biting<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla recently teased a Cybercab launch event, which could be a catalyst to send shares higher. The stock, however, hasn’t reacted yet, which says something about what market expectations.
